name: datetimepicker.js
description: A flexible and customizable JavaScript DateTime picker supporting inline, input, and button modes, with calendar, time sliders, UTC/local toggle, Day of Year support, and Bootstrap 5 styling.
author: Umer Salman

scripts.build: node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('dist', { recursive: true })" && npx esbuild datetimepicker.js --minify --outfile=dist/datetimepicker.min.js && npx esbuild datetimepicker.css --minify --outfile=dist/datetimepicker.min.css
